text:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall: p99 spike detected for tenant xenovate in eu-west dedicated pool (dedicated-eu-west-3). Auto-ticket INC-2026-789 created. Logs: high queue depth on GPU shard 2.

sre-ian: I'm on it, joining call now. Can someone post customer impact?

ps-olivia: Xenovate reporting timeouts on inference requests, internal metric shows p99 ~ 3.8s (baseline 0.6s). Affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. They've got an active release but unsure if it's correlated.

account-amy: Pinged xenovate-ops, they confirm increased throughput from a ramped job. They've paused but spike continued. Customer is sensitive — enterprise contract, SLA 99.9.

eng-runtime-jules: Noted KV cache miss rate jumped and batching backlog on shard2. I can try to move some tenants off that shard. Suggest isolating xenovate to a temp-capacity pool and reduce concurrency.

support-lee: Collecting sample request IDs from customer to trace: req_7c3f, req_b2a1. Adding to INC-2026-789.

eng-runtime-jules: Doing isolation now. Command: ```
# isolate tenant xenovate to soft-quarantine ondedicated pool
rbctl tenant isolate --tenant xenovate --pool dedicated-eu-west-soft-1 --mode throttle --concurrency 8
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: tenant isolation triggered by eng-runtime-jules at 4987654380.

sre-ian: After isolate: p99 dropped to ~1.2s, queue length down 70%. But throughput still high, risk of impacting neighbors if we fully unquarantine.

eng-runtime-jules: Next step: spin up warm spare node and enable fallback model routing for heavy requests. Command: ```
rbctl pool scale --pool dedicated-eu-west-3 --add-nodes 2 --type warm-spare
rbctl routing set --tenant xenovate --fallback-model small-gen-v1 --split 30
```

ps-olivia: Notifying customer: scheduled a short join to confirm they're paused and to coordinate rollback of their spike. @account-amy can you lead the call?

account-amy: On it, dialing xenovate-ops now. Will request timestamped logs and ask them to hold traffic.

xenovate-ops: Thanks team. We paused the ramp (stopped the job). Happy to keep traffic routed to fallback while we investigate release. Please keep us updated on ETA to remove isolation.

support-lee: Collected traces show a particular job type with long contexts causing KV miss churn. Filing a follow-up with runtime team for mitigation and a recommended limit on context size.

eng-runtime-jules: Hotfix note: we'll add a temporary prefix-cache for xenovate to reduce KV churn and recommend they back off long-context batch jobs until we patch. ETA for patch in ~2 hours.

incident-bot: INC-2026-789 updated: status = mitigated, impact = degraded (customer requests routed to fallback), priority = P1 -> P2 after isolation. Next steps logged in ticket. :white_check_mark:

sre-ian: Closing loop: keep isolation for 1 hour, monitor p99 and neighbor impact. If stable, start gradual unquarantine and restore normal routing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
